en.t: Odoacer, chieftain of the Germanic tribes (Herulic – Scirian foederati), is proclaimed rex Italiae ("King of Italy") by his troops
en.s: Odoacer (c. 433 – 15 March 493 AD), also spelled Odovacer or Odovacar, was a barbarian soldier and statesman from the Middle Danube who, as an officer of the Roman army, deposed the Western Roman child emperor Romulus Augustulus to become the ruler of Italy in the period 476–493 AD. His takeover is traditionally understood as marking the end of the Western Roman Empire.

zh.t: 日耳曼部族首领奥多亚塞被部下拥立为意大利之王（rex Italiae）
zh.s: 奥多亚塞（约433年—493年3月15日），也作奥多瓦塞或奥多瓦卡，是来自多瑙河中游地区的军人和政治家。他曾在罗马军队任职，废黜年幼的西罗马皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都路斯，并于476年至493年统治意大利。这一权力更迭通常被视为西罗马帝国终结的标志。

en.s: The Battle at Brůdek (Czech bitva u Brůdku; German Schlacht bei Stokau, Schlacht bei Biwanka) was fought between Henry III, King of the Romans, and Břetislav I, Duke of Bohemia, on 22/23 August 1040. The battle took place in the Upper Palatine Forest in what is now the Domažlice District of Plzeň Region, Czech Republic.

zh.s: 布鲁德克战役（捷克语：bitva u Brůdku；德语：Schlacht bei Stokau、Schlacht bei Biwanka）于1040年8月22日至23日发生，交战双方是罗马人民的国王亨利三世和波希米亚公爵布热季斯拉夫一世。战场位于上普法尔茨森林，也就是今天捷克比尔森州多马日利采区一带。

en.s: The Battle of the Blacks or Battle of the Slaves was a conflict in Cairo that occurred during the Rise of Saladin in Egypt, on 21–23 August 1169, between the black African units of the Fatimid army and other pro-Fatimid elements, and Sunni Syrian troops loyal to the Fatimid vizier, Saladin.

en.s: The siege of Jerusalem of 1244 took place after the Sixth Crusade, when a Khwarazmian army conquered the city on July 15, 1244.

zh.t: 耶路撒冷围城战：该城向花剌子模人投降，基督教势力对耶路撒冷的控制就此中断672年
zh.s: 1244年耶路撒冷围城战发生在第六次十字军东征之后；花剌子模军队于1244年7月15日攻占该城。

en.s: The Battle of Tagliacozzo was fought on 23 August 1268 between the Ghibellines supporters of Conradin of Hohenstaufen and the army of Charles of Anjou. The battle represented the last act of Hohenstaufen power in Italy. The end of Conradin marked also the fall of the family from the Imperial and Sicilian thrones, leading to the new chapter of Angevin domination in Southern Italy.

zh.s: 1268年8月23日，霍亨斯陶芬家族的康拉丁支持者、吉卜林派与安茹的查理率领的军队交战。这场战役标志着霍亨斯陶芬家族在意大利势力的终结。康拉丁的命运也标志着该家族失去神圣罗马帝国和西西里王位，意大利南部由此进入安茹王朝统治时期。

en.s: (For other battles, see Battle of Cassel (disambiguation).) On 23 August 1328, the Battle of Cassel took place near the city of Cassel, 30 km south of Dunkirk in present-day France. Philip VI, (King of France from 1328 to 1350) fought Nicolaas Zannekin, a wealthy farmer from Lampernisse. Zannekin was the leader of a band of Flemish independence rebels. The fighting erupted over taxation and punitive edicts of the French over the Flemish. The battle was won decisively by the French. Zannekin and about 3200 Flemish rebels were killed in the battle.

zh.s: 1328年8月23日，卡塞勒战役在法国今卡塞勒附近爆发，地点在敦刻尔克以南30公里。法国国王腓力六世（在位于1328年至1350年）与来自兰佩尼斯的富裕农民尼古拉斯·赞内金交战。赞内金是佛兰德独立起义军的领袖。战斗因法国对佛兰德人征税并颁布惩罚性法令而起。法军取得决定性胜利，赞内金和约3200名佛兰德起义者阵亡。

en.t: Knights Hospitaller invasion of Despotate of Arta
en.s: The Knights Hospitaller invasion of the Despotate of Arta was a military campaign conducted by the Knights Hospitaller, led by Grand Master Juan Fernández de Heredia. The campaign targeted the Despotate of Arta, ruled by Gjin Bua Shpata. The invasion was sanctioned by Pope Gregory XI.

zh.s: 医院骑士团在大团长胡安·费尔南德斯·德·埃雷迪亚率领下发起军事行动，目标是由金·布阿·什帕塔统治的阿尔塔专制公国。教宗额我略十一世批准了这次入侵。

en.s: The siege of Moscow in 1382 was a battle between the Principality of Moscow and Tokhtamysh, khan of the Golden Horde. In August 1382, Tokhtamysh led a large army toward Moscow. At that time, Prince Dmitry Donskoy was not in the city as he was seeking assistance from other Russian territories. As a result, Moscow's defense was left in the hands of the people and a small garrison.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1382年的莫斯科围城战是莫斯科公国与金帐汗国可汗脱脱迷失之间的一场战斗。1382年8月，脱脱迷失率大军向莫斯科进发。当时，德米特里·顿斯科伊大公不在城内，正在其他俄罗斯领地寻求援助，因此莫斯科的防守落在民众和一支小型守军肩上。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Chaldiran (Persian: جنگ چالدران‎‎; Turkish: Çaldıran Muharebesi) took place on 23 August 1514 and ended with a decisive victory for the Ottoman Empire over the Safavid Empire. As a result, the Ottomans annexed eastern Anatolia and northern Iraq from Safavid Iran for the first time. It marked the first Ottoman expansion into eastern Anatolia, and the halt of the Safavid expansion to the west. Despite the Iranians briefly reconquering the area over the course of the centuries, the battle marked the first event that would eventually, through many wars and treaties later, lead to its permanent conquest, until the dissolution of the Ottoman Empire centuries later.

zh.s: 查尔迪兰战役（波斯语：جنگ چالدران；土耳其语：Çaldıran Muharebesi）于1514年8月23日爆发，以奥斯曼帝国决定性击败萨法维帝国告终。奥斯曼帝国由此首次从萨法维伊朗手中吞并安纳托利亚东部和伊拉克北部。这标志着奥斯曼帝国首次向安纳托利亚东部扩张，也阻止了萨法维帝国继续向西扩张。虽然伊朗在之后几个世纪里曾短暂收复该地区，但这场战役开启了此后通过多次战争和条约最终永久征服该地区的进程，直到几个世纪后的奥斯曼帝国解体。

en.t: Christian II of Denmark is deposed as king of Sweden and Gustav Vasa is elected regent
en.s: Christian II (1 July 1481 – 25 January 1559) was a monarch under the Kalmar Union, reigning as King of Denmark and Norway from 1513 until 1523. He was briefly King of Sweden from 1520 until 1521. As king of Denmark, he was concurrently Duke of Schleswig and Holstein in joint rule with his uncle Frederick.

zh.t: 丹麦国王克里斯蒂安二世被废黜瑞典王位，古斯塔夫·瓦萨获选为摄政
zh.s: 克里斯蒂安二世（1481年7月1日—1559年1月25日）是卡尔马联盟时期的君主，1513年至1523年担任丹麦和挪威国王。他于1520年至1521年短暂担任瑞典国王。作为丹麦国王，他还与叔父腓特烈共同统治石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因，并兼任两地公爵。

en.t: French explorer Jacques Cartier lands near Quebec City in his third voyage to Canada
en.s: Jacques Cartier (Breton: Jakez Karter; 31 December 1491 – 1 September 1557) was a French maritime explorer from Brittany. Jacques Cartier was the first European to describe and map the Gulf of Saint Lawrence and the shores of the Saint Lawrence River, which he named "Canada" after the Iroquoian names for the two big settlements he saw at Stadacona (Quebec City) and at Hochelaga (Montreal Island).

zh.t: 法国探险家雅克·卡蒂埃第三次远征加拿大，在魁北克市附近登陆
zh.s: 雅克·卡蒂埃（布列塔尼语：Jakez Karter；1491年12月31日—1557年9月1日）是来自布列塔尼的法国航海探险家。他是首位描述并绘制圣劳伦斯湾及圣劳伦斯河沿岸地图的欧洲人；他以“加拿大”称呼该地区，名称取自他在斯塔达科纳（魁北克市）和奥什拉加（蒙特利尔岛）见到的易洛魁人两处大型聚居地的名称。

en.s: The Saint Bartholomew's Day massacre (French: Massacre de la Saint-Barthélemy) in 1572 was a targeted group of assassinations and a wave of Catholic mob violence directed against the Huguenots (French Calvinist Protestants) during the French Wars of Religion. Traditionally believed to have been instigated by Queen Catherine de' Medici, the mother of King Charles IX, the massacre started a few days after the marriage on 18 August of the king's sister Margaret to the Protestant King Henry III of Navarre. Many of the wealthiest and most prominent Huguenots had gathered in largely Catholic Paris to attend the wedding. The massacre began in the night of 23–24 August 1572, the eve of the Feast of Saint Bartholomew, two days after the attempted assassination of Admiral Gaspard de Coligny, the military and political leader of the Huguenots.

zh.s: 1572年的圣巴多罗买大屠杀发生于法国宗教战争期间，是针对胡格诺派（法国加尔文派新教徒）的一系列定向暗杀和天主教暴民暴力事件。传统说法认为，事件由查理九世的母亲、王太后凯瑟琳·德·美第奇煽动。国王的妹妹玛格丽特于8月18日与新教徒、纳瓦拉国王亨利三世成婚，几天后屠杀开始。许多富有且有声望的胡格诺派人士聚集在天主教徒占多数的巴黎参加婚礼。1572年8月23日至24日夜间、圣巴多罗买节前夕，屠杀开始；此前两天，胡格诺派军事和政治领袖加斯帕尔·德·科利尼海军上将曾遭遇刺杀未遂。

en.s: The Battle of Pyongyang was a military engagement in 1592, as part of the 1592–1598 Japanese invasions of Korea. On 23 August 1592 a Ming force of 6,000 under Zu Chengxun and Shi Ru attacked Japanese-occupied Pyeongyang and was defeated.

zh.s: 平壤之战是1592年发生的一场军事交战，属于1592至1598年日本侵略朝鲜战争的一部分。1592年8月23日，祖承训和史儒率领6000名明军进攻日军占领的平壤，结果战败。

en.s: The Battle of Călugăreni took place during the history of early modern Romania on 23 August [O.S. 13 August] 1595 between the Wallachian army led by Michael the Brave and the Ottoman army led by Koca Sinan Pasha. It was part of the Long Turkish War, fought between Christian and Ottoman forces at the end of the 16th and the beginning of the 17th centuries.

zh.s: 克勒鲁尼战役发生于1595年8月23日（儒略历8月13日），交战双方是米哈伊勇敢者率领的瓦拉几亚军队和科贾·锡南帕夏率领的奥斯曼军队。战役属于长期土耳其战争的一部分；这场战争发生在16世纪末至17世纪初，由基督教势力与奥斯曼帝国交战。

en.s: The Battle of Gifu Castle (岐阜城の戦い, Gifu-jō no Tatakai) took place in September 1600 that led to the destruction of Gifu Castle in Gifu, Mino Province (modern-day Gifu Prefecture), Japan. The battle served as a prelude to the Battle of Sekigahara the following month. It pitted Oda Hidenobu of the Ishida Mitsunari western forces against Ikeda Terumasa, Ikeda Sen, and Fukushima Masanori of the eastern forces and loyal to Tokugawa Ieyasu.
en.n: Battle of Gifu Castle: The eastern forces of Tokugawa Ieyasu defeat the western Japanese clans loyal to Toyotomi Hideyori, leading to the destruction of Gifu Castle and serving as a prelude to the Battle of Sekigahara.

zh.s: 岐阜城之战（岐阜城の戦い，Gifu-jō no Tatakai）发生于1600年9月，导致日本美浓国岐阜（今岐阜县）的岐阜城被毁。此战是次月关原之战的前奏。西军石田三成麾下的织田秀信，与东军中效忠德川家康的池田辉政、池田千、福岛正则交战。
zh.n: 岐阜城之战：德川家康率领的东军击败效忠丰臣秀赖的日本西军诸藩，岐阜城因此被毁，也为关原之战拉开序幕。

en.s: The Portuguese conquest of Maranhão took place between 23 August 1612 and 3 November 1615, in the state of Maranhão, Brazil, between Portuguese and Tabajara forces, on the one hand, and French and Tupinambá forces, on the other. The campaign resulted in the definitive expulsion of the French from Maranhão on November 4, 1615. The expulsion of the French allowed a large part of the Amazon to fall under Portuguese dominion.

zh.s: 葡萄牙对马拉尼昂的征服发生于1612年8月23日至1615年11月3日，地点在巴西马拉尼昂州。交战双方分别是葡萄牙人与塔巴哈拉人，以及法国人与图皮南巴人。战役最终导致法国人于1615年11月4日被彻底逐出马拉尼昂。法国人被逐后，亚马孙地区大部分落入葡萄牙统治之下。

en.t: George Villiers, the first Duke of Buckingham, is assassinated by John Felton
en.s: George Villiers, 1st Duke of Buckingham ( VIL-ərz; 20 August 1592 – 23 August 1628), was an English courtier and statesman who was a notable patron of the arts. He was a favourite and self-described "lover" of King James VI and I. Buckingham remained at the height of royal favour for the first three years of the reign of James's son, Charles I, until he was assassinated.

zh.t: 白金汉公爵乔治·维利尔斯遭约翰·费尔顿刺杀
zh.s: 第一代白金汉公爵乔治·维利尔斯（1592年8月20日—1628年8月23日）是英国宫廷重臣和政治家，也是著名艺术赞助人。他深受詹姆斯六世及一世宠信，并自称是国王的“爱人”。查理一世即位后的头三年里，他仍备受宠信，直至遭到刺杀。

en.s: The siege of Brno, which occurred from 3 May to 23 August 1645, was the second Swedish siege of the city of Brno in the last years of the Thirty Years' War. The Brno garrison, consisting of 500 soldiers and about 1,000 Brno residents, successfully defended the city against about 28,000 soldiers of General Lennart Torstensson.

zh.s: 1645年5月3日至8月23日，瑞典军队第二次围攻布尔诺，这是三十年战争末期的一场战役。布尔诺守军由500名士兵和约1000名当地居民组成，成功抵挡了伦纳特·托尔斯滕森将军率领的约2.8万名士兵。

en.s: The Battle of Sobota was a battle that took place near Sobota, Poland, on 23 August 1655, between the armies of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth on the one hand and of Sweden on the other. After Charles X Gustav's entry into Poland, he made camp at Koło. Here the Swedish king received representatives from John II Casimir of Poland in an attempt to sue for peace. The Polish attempts were in vain and the Swedish king marched towards Warsaw. John II Casimir put up a small army in order to hinder the Swedish advance while seeking assistance from other rulers.

zh.s: 1655年8月23日，波兰—立陶宛联邦军队与瑞典军队在波兰索博塔附近交战。卡尔十世·古斯塔夫率军进入波兰后，在科沃扎营。瑞典国王在此接见了波兰国王约翰二世·卡西米尔派来的代表，对方试图请求和谈，但没有成功。随后瑞典国王向华沙进军。约翰二世·卡西米尔组建一支小部队阻止瑞典军推进，同时向其他统治者寻求援助。

en.s: The Battle of Norridgewock, also known as the Norridgewock Massacre, was a raid on the Abenaki settlement of Norridgewock by a group of colonial militiamen from the New England Colonies. Occurring in contested lands on the edge of the American frontier, the raid resulted in the massacre of the Abenaki inhabitants of Norridgewock by the militiamen.

zh.s: 诺里奇沃克之战也称“诺里奇沃克大屠杀”，是新英格兰殖民地的民兵突袭阿贝纳基人在诺里奇沃克的聚居地。袭击发生在争议地区，靠近美国边疆地带；民兵屠杀了当地的阿贝纳基居民。

en.s: The battle of Villmanstrand was fought during the Russo-Swedish War on August 23, 1741, when Russian forces, under the command of General Peter von Lacy, assaulted Villmanstrand (Finnish: Lappeenranta). Fighting began around 2 pm but the Swedes withdrew already at 5 pm. Swedish casualties amounted to 2,000 men killed or wounded and 1,000 captured, among them General Carl Henrik Wrangel. Russia lost 2,400 men. Von Lacy did not continue his movement after the battle. Henrik Magnus Buddenbrock was executed for his perceived incompetency.

zh.s: 1741年8月23日，俄军在俄瑞战争期间进攻拉彭兰塔（芬兰语：Lappeenranta），由彼得·冯·拉西将军指挥。战斗约于下午2时开始，瑞典军队在下午5时便已撤退。瑞典方面有2,000人死伤、1,000人被俘，其中包括卡尔·亨里克·朗格尔将军。俄军损失2,400人。战后冯·拉西没有继续推进。亨里克·马格努斯·布登布洛克因被认为指挥不力而遭处决。

en.s: The siege of Geldern was one of the first military confrontations between France and Prussia during the Seven Years' War. Surrounded by an advancing French army, the Prussian garrison of Geldern surrendered after a four-month siege.

en.s: The Burmese–Siamese War of 1765–1767, also known as the War of the Second Fall of Ayutthaya (Thai: สงครามคราวเสียกรุงศรีอยุธยาครั้งที่สอง) was the second military conflict between Burma under the Konbaung dynasty and Ayutthaya Kingdom under the Siamese Ban Phlu Luang dynasty that lasted from 1765 until 1767; the war ended the 417-year-old Ayutthaya Kingdom. Burma under the new Konbaung dynasty emerged powerful in the mid-18th century.

en.s: The Action of 23 August 1806 was a minor naval battle of the Napoleonic wars, fought off the coast of Spanish Cuba near the port of Havana. The Spanish frigate Pomona was captured by the frigates HMS Anson and HMS Arethusa under the commands of Captain Charles Lydiard and Charles Brisbane respectively. As well as the frigate being captured, a shore battery was silenced and a fleet of gunboats was defeated.

en.s: In the Battles of Großbeeren and neighboring Blankenfelde and Sputendorf (23 August 1813) an allied Prussian-Swedish army under Crown Prince Charles John – formerly Marshal of France Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte – defeated the French under Marshal Oudinot. Napoleon had hoped to drive the Prussians out of the Sixth Coalition by capturing their capital, but the swamps south of Berlin combined with rain and the Marshal's ill health all contributed to the French defeat.

zh.s: 1813年8月23日，查理·约翰王储（原法国元帅让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特）率领普鲁士—瑞典联军，在格罗斯贝伦及附近的布兰肯费尔德和施普滕多夫击败了乌迪诺元帅指挥的法军。拿破仑希望攻占普鲁士首都，使普鲁士退出第六次反法同盟，但柏林以南的沼泽、降雨以及乌迪诺身体不适都导致法军战败。

en.s: The Battle of Goldberg was a battle taking place during the Napoleonic Wars, fought in the War of the Sixth Coalition on August 23, 1813. It was a minor victory for French military leader Étienne Macdonald's Army of the Bobr. Just 3 days after the Combat of Goldberg, Macdonald's army suffered an overwhelming loss, an event that helped lead to the effects of Napoleon Bonaparte's victory at Dresden, the War of Liberation, being undone.

zh.s: 戈尔德贝格战斗发生于拿破仑战争期间，是第六次反法同盟战争的一场战斗，日期为1813年8月23日。法国将领艾蒂安·麦克唐纳指挥的博布尔军团小胜。3天后，麦克唐纳的军队遭遇惨败，这场失利促使拿破仑·波拿巴在德累斯顿的胜利成果在解放战争中被逆转。

en.s: Nat Turner's Rebellion (also known as the Southampton Insurrection) was a slave rebellion that took place in Southampton County, Virginia, during August 1831. Led by Nat Turner, rebel slaves killed from 55 to 65 people, the highest number of fatalities caused by any slave uprising in the Southern United States. The rebellion was put down within a few days, but Turner survived in hiding for more than two months afterwards. The rebellion was effectively suppressed at Belmont Plantation on the morning of August 23, 1831. There was widespread fear in the aftermath of the rebellion, and white militias organized in retaliation against the slaves.

zh.s: 纳特·特纳起义又称南安普敦起义，是1831年8月发生在弗吉尼亚州南安普敦县的一场奴隶起义。纳特·特纳领导起义者杀害了55至65人，是美国南方地区死亡人数最多的奴隶起义。几天内起义便被镇压，但特纳此后躲藏了两个多月。1831年8月23日上午，起义在贝尔蒙特种植园一带基本被镇压。起义后当地普遍恐慌，白人民兵组织起来报复奴隶。

en.s: The Assault on Germenchuk, also known as the Battle of Germenchuk, was a military engagement fought between the forces of the Caucasian Imamate and the Russian Empire on 23 August 1832. This battle was one of the key engagements of the Murid War, with some 9,000 Russian troops under the command of General A. A. Velyaminov stormed the Chechen village, where they met 3,800 defenders.

zh.s: 格尔门丘克之战又称对格尔门丘克的进攻，是高加索伊玛目国与俄罗斯帝国军队于1832年8月23日发生的一场军事交战。这是穆里德战争中的重要战役之一。维利亚米诺夫将军率领约9000名俄军进攻车臣村庄，遭遇3800名守军。

Dakota forces attacked New Ulm on August 19 and again on August 23, destroying much of the town but failing to fully capture it.

en.t: The Albert Bridge in Chelsea, London opens
en.s: Albert Bridge is a road bridge over the River Thames connecting Chelsea on the north bank to Battersea on the south. Designed and built by Rowland Mason Ordish in 1873 as an Ordish–Lefeuvre system modified cable-stayed bridge, it proved to be structurally unsound, so between 1884 and 1887 Sir Joseph Bazalgette incorporated some of the design elements of a suspension bridge.

zh.s: 阿尔伯特桥是一座横跨泰晤士河的公路桥，连接北岸的切尔西和南岸的巴特西。桥梁由罗兰·梅森·奥迪什设计并于1873年建成，采用奥迪什—勒弗夫尔式改良斜拉桥结构，但后来被证明结构不稳。因此，约瑟夫·巴泽尔杰特爵士在1884年至1887年间为它加入了一些悬索桥设计元素。

en.s: Nicola Sacco (Italian: [niˈkɔːla ˈsakko]; April 22, 1891 – August 23, 1927) and Bartolomeo Vanzetti (Italian: [bartoloˈmɛːo vanˈtsetti, -ˈdzet-]; June 11, 1888 – August 23, 1927) were Italian immigrants and anarchists, controversially accused of murdering Alessandro Berardelli and Frederick Parmenter, a guard and a paymaster, during the April 15, 1920, armed robbery of the Slater and Morrill Shoe Company in Braintree, Massachusetts, United States.

en.s: The Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, officially the Treaty of Non-Aggression between Germany and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, was a non-aggression pact between Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union, with a secret protocol establishing Soviet and German spheres of influence across Eastern Europe. zh.s: 《苏德互不侵犯条约》的正式名称是《德意志国与苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟互不侵犯条约》。纳粹德国与苏联签署了这项条约，并通过秘密议定书划定双方在东欧的势力范围。1939年8月24日，苏联部长会议主席兼外交人民委员维亚切斯拉夫·莫洛托夫和德国外交部长约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫在莫斯科签署条约，签署日期回填为8月23日。

en.s: The Battle of Stalingrad was a major battle on the Eastern Front of World War II in which Nazi Germany and its Axis allies fought the Soviet Union for control of the city of Stalingrad (now Volgograd) in southern Russia. Marked by intense close-quarters combat and heavy civilian losses during aerial bombardment, the battle is considered the largest and deadliest urban battle in military history and the deadliest battle in World War II.

en.s: Gruppe Eisbär (Group Polar Bear) was a force of German U-boats that operated from 23 August 1942 in the South Atlantic during the Second World War. The group was to operate off Cape Town, which was considered to be vulnerable. Some of the most experienced U-boat commanders including Harald Gelhaus, Werner Hartenstein and Carl Emmermann participated in the operation.

en.s: The Belgorod–Kharkov strategic offensive operation, or simply Belgorod–Kharkov offensive operation, was a Soviet strategic summer offensive that aimed to liberate Belgorod and Kharkov, and destroy Nazi German forces of the 4th Panzer Army and Army Detachment Kempf. The operation was codenamed Operation General Rumyantsev (Russian: Полководец Румянцев), after the 18th-century Field Marshal Peter Rumyantsev and was conducted by the Voronezh and Steppe Fronts (army groups) in the southern sector of the Kursk Bulge.

zh.t: 别尔哥罗德—哈尔科夫进攻战役
zh.s: 别尔哥罗德—哈尔科夫战略进攻战役又称别尔哥罗德—哈尔科夫进攻战役，是苏联在夏季发动的一场战略进攻，目标是解放别尔哥罗德和哈尔科夫，并消灭纳粹德国的第4装甲集团军和肯普夫集群。该行动代号“鲁缅采夫将军行动”，名称取自18世纪元帅彼得·鲁缅采夫，由沃罗涅日方面军和草原方面军（集团军群）在库尔斯克突出部南段实施。

en.t: World War II: Kharkiv is liberated by the Soviet Red Army for the second time after the Battle of Kursk
en.s: The Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, often referred by its shortened name as the Red Army, was the army and air force of the Russian Soviet Republic and, from 1922, the Soviet Union. The army was established in January 1918 by a decree of the Council of People's Commissars to oppose the military forces of the new nation's adversaries during the Russian Civil War, especially the various groups collectively known as the White Army.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：库尔斯克战役后，苏联红军第二次解放哈尔科夫
zh.s: 工农红军通常简称红军，是俄罗斯苏维埃共和国、以及自1922年起苏联的陆军和空军。红军于1918年1月根据人民委员会法令成立，旨在俄国内战期间对抗新国家的敌对军事力量，尤其是统称为白军的各派势力。

en.t: Second World War: A decisive Soviet victory against German forces at the Battle of Kursk gave the Red Army the strategic initiative for the rest of the war
en.s: The Battle of Kursk, also called the Battle of the Kursk Salient, was a major World War II Eastern Front battle between the forces of Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union near Kursk in southwestern Russia during the summer of 1943, resulting in a Soviet victory. The Battle of Kursk is the single largest battle in the history of warfare.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：库尔斯克战役中苏军决定性获胜，取得战争后续阶段的战略主动权
zh.s: 库尔斯克战役也称库尔斯克突出部战役，是1943年夏季第二次世界大战东线的一场重要战役，交战双方为纳粹德国和苏联，战场位于俄罗斯西南部库尔斯克附近。战役以苏联获胜告终，被称为战争史上规模最大的一场战役。

en.s: On 23 August 1944, a United States Army Air Forces (USAAF) Consolidated B-24H Liberator crashed during a test flight into the centre of the village of Freckleton, Lancashire, England, killing all three crewmen aboard the aircraft and 58 individuals on the ground, including 38 children aged four to six. An official inquiry was unable to pinpoint an exact cause for the accident, although a sudden thunderstorm and the resultant reduced visibility immediately prior to the accident had caused the test pilot of the B-24H, First Lieutenant John Bloemendal, to be ordered to abandon the test flight and attempt to return to base.

zh.s: 1944年8月23日，美国陆军航空军一架联合飞机公司B-24H“解放者”轰炸机在试飞途中坠入英格兰兰开夏郡弗雷克尔顿村中心。机上3名机组人员和地面58人遇难，其中包括38名4至6岁的儿童。官方调查未能确定事故的确切原因；不过，事故发生前突如其来的雷暴导致能见度下降，B-24H试飞员约翰·布卢门达尔中尉因此接到命令，放弃试飞并尝试返航。

en.s: The Battle of the Audierne Bay took place on 23 August 1944 and was an engagement between German and Allied naval flotillas. Three Allied warships, which had already established control off the coast of Brittany and were lurking off Audierne south of the invested fortress of Brest, intercepted and sank eight German vessels of an armed convoy.

zh.s: 1944年8月23日，德军与盟军舰队在奥迪耶讷湾交战。三艘盟军军舰此前已控制布列塔尼海岸附近海域，并埋伏在被围困的布雷斯特要塞以南、奥迪耶讷附近，随后拦截并击沉一支武装船队中的8艘德国船只。

en.s: The 1944 Romanian coup d'état, better known in Romanian historiography as the Act of 23 August (Romanian: Actul de la 23 august), was a coup d'état led by King Michael I of Romania during World War II on 23 August 1944. With the support of several political parties, the king removed the government of Ion Antonescu, which had aligned Romania with Nazi Germany, after the Axis front in northeastern Romania collapsed in the face of a successful Soviet offensive.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，罗马尼亚国王米哈伊一世于1944年8月23日领导政变。这场政变在罗马尼亚史学中更常称为“八月二十三日行动”。在几个政党的支持下，国王罢免了扬·安东内斯库政府。该政府曾使罗马尼亚与纳粹德国结盟；此前，苏军攻势取得成功，轴心国在罗马尼亚东北部的战线随之崩溃。

en.s: The Battle of Shumshu, the Soviet invasion of Shumshu in the Kuril Islands, was the first stage of the Soviet Union's Invasion of the Kuril Islands in August–September 1945 during World War II. It took place from 18 to 23 August 1945, and was the only major battle of the Soviet campaign in the Kuril Islands and arguably the very last battle of World War II.

zh.s: 占守岛战役是第二次世界大战期间苏联入侵千岛群岛的第一阶段，发生于1945年8月至9月。战役于1945年8月18日至23日进行，是苏联千岛群岛战役中唯一一场大规模战斗，也有人认为它是第二次世界大战的最后一场战役。

The festival was founded by Beretta Bolla, Riccardo Bolla, film critic Vinicio Beretta, Locarno theater owner André Mondini, and Giuseppe Padlin of the distribution house Sefi Film.

zh.s: 首届洛迦诺电影节于1946年8月23日至9月2日在瑞士洛迦诺大酒店举行。开幕影片是贾科莫·真蒂洛莫执导的《我的太阳》（O sole mio）。电影节由贝雷塔·博拉、里卡多·博拉、影评人维尼乔·贝雷塔、洛迦诺剧院老板安德烈·蒙迪尼，以及发行公司Sefi Film的朱塞佩·帕德林创办。

en.t: The World Council of Churches is formed by 147 churches from 44 countries
en.s: The World Council of Churches (WCC) is a worldwide Christian inter-church organization founded in 1948 to work for the cause of ecumenism. Its full members today include the Assyrian Church of the East, most jurisdictions of the Eastern Orthodox Church (including the Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople), the Oriental Orthodox Churches, the Union of Utrecht, the Lutheran World Federation, the Anglican Communion, the Mennonite churches, the World Methodist Council, the Baptist World Alliance, the World Communion of Reformed Churches, the Moravian Church, the Malankara Mar Thoma Syrian Church, and several Pentecostal churches (but not the Pentecostal World Fellowship or the Assemblies of God).

zh.t: 来自44个国家的147个教会共同成立世界基督教协进会
zh.s: 世界基督教协进会（WCC）是一个全球性的基督教跨宗派组织，成立于1948年，致力于推动普世合一运动。其现有正式成员包括东方亚述教会、东正教会的大多数辖区（包括君士坦丁堡普世牧首区）、东方正统教会、乌得勒支联盟、路德宗世界联合会、普世圣公宗、门诺派教会、世界循道宗协会、浸信会世界联盟、普世改革宗教会联合会、摩拉维亚教会、马兰卡拉·马尔托马叙利亚教会以及若干五旬节派教会（但不包括五旬节世界团契或神召会）。

en.t: The Cruise of the Kings, a royal cruise organised by the Queen Consort of Greece, Frederica of Hanover, departs from Marseille, France
en.s: The Cruise of the Kings (Greek: Η κρουαζιέρα των γαλαζοαίματων, romanized: I krouaziéra ton galazoématon, lit. 'The cruise of the blue-bloods') was a royal cruise around the Mediterranean Sea in the summer of 1954, organised by Queen Frederica and King Paul of Greece. The cruise aimed to promote tourism in Greece and was drafted by Queen Frederica. It took place from 23 August to 3 September 1954 on the royal yacht Agamemnon.

zh.t: 希腊王后腓特烈卡组织的“国王巡游”从法国马赛启航
zh.s: “国王巡游”（希腊语原名意为“贵族巡游”）是1954年夏季在地中海举行的一次皇家巡游，由希腊王后腓特烈卡和国王保罗组织，旨在促进希腊旅游业。巡游方案由腓特烈卡拟定，1954年8月23日至9月3日乘皇家游艇“阿伽门农号”进行。

en.t: The first flight of the Lockheed C-130 multi-role aircraft takes place
en.s: The Lockheed C-130 Hercules is an American, four-engined, turboprop, military transport aircraft designed and built by Lockheed (now Lockheed Martin). Capable of using unprepared runways for takeoffs and landings, the C-130 was designed as a troop, medical evacuation, and cargo transport aircraft. Its versatile airframe has found other uses, including as a gunship (AC-130), for airborne assault, search and rescue, scientific research support, weather reconnaissance, aerial refueling, maritime patrol, and aerial firefighting.

zh.t: 洛克希德C-130多用途飞机首飞
zh.s: 洛克希德C-130“大力神”是美国制造的四引擎涡轮螺旋桨军用运输机，由洛克希德公司（现洛克希德·马丁公司）设计和制造。C-130能够在未经整备的跑道上起降，最初设计用于运兵、医疗后送和货物运输。其多用途机体后来还用于其他任务，包括改装为炮艇机（AC-130）、空降突击、搜索与救援、科学研究支援、气象侦察、空中加油、海上巡逻和空中灭火。

en.s: The Second Taiwan Strait Crisis, also known as the 1958 Taiwan Strait Crisis, was a conflict between the People's Republic of China (PRC) and the Republic of China (ROC). The PRC shelled the islands of Kinmen (Quemoy) and the Matsu Islands along the east coast of mainland China in an attempt to take them from the ROC, governed by the Kuomintang (KMT), and to probe the extent of American commitment to defend the Republic of China.

zh.s: 第二次台湾海峡危机又称1958年台湾海峡危机，是中华人民共和国与中华民国之间的一场冲突。中华人民共和国炮击了金门和马祖列岛，试图从由中国国民党执政的中华民国手中夺取这些岛屿，同时试探美国保卫中华民国的决心。

en.s: Elections to the Legislative Assembly of the Indian Union Territory of Pondicherry took place on 23 August 1964. These were the first Legislative Assembly elections after the formation of the new Union Territory. The elections marked the end of the rule of Edouard Goubert in Pondicherry.

zh.s: 印度联邦属地本地治里的立法议会选举于1964年8月23日举行。这是新联邦属地成立后的首届立法议会选举，也标志着爱德华·古贝尔在本地治里的统治结束。

en.s: The 1967 Denmark v Iceland football match was an international friendly association football match between the senior national teams of Denmark and Iceland. The match took place on 23 August 1967 at Idrætsparken in Copenhagen, Denmark. The match finished as a 14–2 win for Denmark and has been called the worst day in the history of Icelandic football.

zh.s: 1967年8月23日，丹麦和冰岛成年国家队在丹麦哥本哈根的伊德雷茨帕肯球场进行了一场国际友谊赛。丹麦以14比2获胜，这场比赛被称为冰岛足球史上最糟糕的一天。

en.s: The action of 23 August 1967 was a major air battle which involved elements of the Vietnam People's Air Force (VPAF) and the United States Air Force (USAF). The air battle took place over the skies of North Vietnam as part of Operation Rolling Thunder, during the Vietnam War.

zh.s: 1967年8月23日，越南人民军空军和美国空军部队在北越上空进行了一场大规模空战。这场空战是越南战争期间“滚雷行动”的一部分。

en.s: The Salad Bowl strike was a series of strikes, mass pickets, boycotts and secondary boycotts that began on August 23, 1970 and led to the largest farm worker strike in U.S. history. The strike was led by the United Farm Workers against the International Brotherhood of Teamsters. The Salad Bowl strike was only in part a jurisdictional strike, for many of the actions taken during the event were not strikes.

zh.s: “沙拉碗”罢工于1970年8月23日开始，包括多轮罢工、大规模纠察、抵制和连带抵制，最终发展为美国历史上规模最大的农业工人罢工。联合农场工人组织领导这场罢工，抗议国际卡车司机兄弟会。此次行动只有部分属于管辖权之争引发的罢工，因为期间采取的许多行动并不属于罢工。

en.s: Milford Oyster Festival, sometimes shortened to "Oysterfest," is an annual cultural festival held on the third Saturday of August throughout the city of Milford, Connecticut. As a major tourist attraction, billed as the largest one-day festival in the New England region and listed among the top 10 annual events in Connecticut, the Oyster Festival draws over 50,000 attendees each year.
en.n: The first Milford Oyster Festival was held on the Milford Green and Fowler Field on 23 August 1975.

zh.s: 米尔福德牡蛎节有时简称“Oysterfest”，是每年8月第三个星期六在康涅狄格州米尔福德全市举行的文化节。该节日是当地重要旅游活动，号称新英格兰地区规模最大的一日节庆，也是康涅狄格州十大年度活动之一，每年吸引超过5万人参加。
zh.n: 米尔福德首届牡蛎节于1975年8月23日在米尔福德绿地和福勒球场举行。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in the Parliament of Lebanon on 23 August 1982, resulting in Lebanese Forces leader Bachir Gemayel being elected President of the Lebanese Republic. By convention, the presidency is always attributed to a Maronite Christian. Under the article 49 of the Lebanese Constitution, a qualified majority of two-thirds of the members of the then 99-seat Lebanese Parliament is required to elect the president in the first round.

zh.s: 1982年8月23日，黎巴嫩议会举行间接总统选举，黎巴嫩长枪党领导人巴希尔·杰马耶勒当选黎巴嫩共和国总统。按照惯例，总统一职由马龙派基督徒担任。根据黎巴嫩宪法第49条，首轮选举总统须获得当时99名议员中的三分之二多数。

en.t: Declaration of State Sovereignty of Armenia
en.s: The Declaration of State Sovereignty of Armenia was signed by Armenia's president Levon Ter-Petrossian and Supreme Council of Armenia secretary Ara Sahakian on August 23, 1990 in Yerevan, Armenia. The Republic of Armenia was established on September 21, 1991 upon dissolution of the Soviet Union. The declaration was rooted in the December 1, 1989, joint decision of the Armenian SSR Supreme Council and the Artsakh National Council on the "Reunification of the Armenian SSR and the Mountainous Region of Karabakh" with ties to the Republic of Armenia established on May 28, 1918 and the Declaration of Independence of Armenia (1918).

zh.t: 亚美尼亚国家主权宣言
zh.s: 亚美尼亚总统列翁·捷尔-彼得罗相和最高苏维埃秘书阿拉·萨哈基扬于1990年8月23日在亚美尼亚首都埃里温签署《亚美尼亚国家主权宣言》。1991年9月21日，苏联解体后亚美尼亚共和国成立。该宣言以1989年12月1日亚美尼亚苏维埃社会主义共和国最高苏维埃与阿尔察赫民族委员会关于“亚美尼亚苏维埃社会主义共和国与纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区统一”的联合决定为基础，并与1918年5月28日成立的亚美尼亚共和国及《1918年亚美尼亚独立宣言》有关。

en.s: Requiem for a Pitbull was a professional wrestling live event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) on August 23, 1996. The event was held in the Bodyslams Arena in Reading, Pennsylvania in the United States. A "fan cam" recording of the event was released on DVD. Requiem for a Pitbull was held to raise money for ECW wrestler Gary "Pitbull #1" Wolfe, who had suffered a cervical fracture of the spine on July 13, 1996 at Heat Wave.

zh.s: 1996年8月23日，极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办了职业摔角现场赛事《斗牛犬安魂曲》，地点在美国宾夕法尼亚州雷丁市的Bodyslams Arena。赛事的粉丝摄像录像后来以DVD发行。举办这场赛事是为了给ECW摔角手加里·“斗牛犬一号”·沃尔夫筹款；他在1996年7月13日的Heat Wave赛事中颈椎骨折。

en.s: The 1997 Supercoppa Italia was the tenth edition of the Supercoppa Italiana. It was played between Juventus, the 1996–97 Serie A winner, and Vicenza, the 1996–97 Coppa Italia winner. Juventus won the match 3–0 and claiming their second Supercoppa Italiana title.

en.s: Gulf Air Flight 072 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Cairo International Airport, Egypt, to Bahrain International Airport, Bahrain, operated by Gulf Air. en.t: The skeletal remains of Russia's last royal family members Alexei Nikolaevich, Tsarevich of Russia, and his sister Grand Duchess Anastasia are discovered near Yekaterinburg, Russia
en.s: Alexei Nikolaevich (Russian: Алексей Николаевич, romanized: Aleksey Nikolaevich; 12 August [O.S. 30 July] 1904 – 17 July 1918) was the last Russian tsesarevich (heir apparent). He was the youngest child and only son of Tsar Nicholas II and Tsarina Alexandra Feodorovna. en.s: On August 23, 2011, a magnitude 5.8 earthquake hit the Piedmont region of the U.S. state of Virginia at 1:51:04 p.m. EDT. The epicenter, in Louisa County, was 38 mi (61 km) northwest of Richmond and 5 mi (8 km) south-southwest of the town of Mineral. It was an intraplate earthquake with a maximum perceived intensity of VIII (Severe) on the Mercalli intensity scale. Several aftershocks, ranging up to 4.5 Mw in magnitude, occurred after the main tremor. The quake was felt across more than a dozen U.S. states and in several Canadian provinces, and was felt by more people than any other quake in U.S. history.

zh.s: 2011年8月23日下午1时51分04秒（美国东部夏令时），美国弗吉尼亚州皮埃蒙特地区发生5.8级地震。震中位于路易莎县，在里士满西北38英里（61公里）、米纳勒尔镇南偏西南5英里（8公里）处。这是一次板内地震，麦加利地震烈度最高达VIII级（严重）。主震后发生多次余震，震级最高达矩震级4.5级。地震在美国十多个州和加拿大数个省份都有震感；美国历史上感受到这次地震的人数超过其他任何一次地震。

zh.s: 2022年8月23日，萨摩亚举行间接选举，选出国家元首（o le Ao o le Malo）。时任元首图伊马莱阿利法诺·瓦阿莱托阿·苏阿劳维二世是唯一候选人，并获一致支持连任。他由总理菲亚梅·瑙米·马塔阿法提名。

en.s: The 2022 Orange County, Florida, mayoral election was held on August 23, 2022, to elect the mayor of Orange County, Florida. Incumbent Jerry Demings was first elected in 2018, and was re-elected in 2022 with 60.05%. Since Demings won a majority in the first round, a runoff election was not needed. The election was officially nonpartisan, but most candidates were affiliated with political parties, and Demings is a registered Democrat.

zh.s: 2022年8月23日举行佛罗里达州奥兰治县县长选举。时任县长杰里·德明斯于2018年首次当选，并在2022年以60.05%的得票率连任。由于德明斯在首轮投票中获得多数票，无需举行决选。此次选举在官方名义上不分党派，但多数候选人与政党有关联，德明斯登记为民主党人。

en.t: 2022 New York's 19th congressional district special election
en.s: The 2022 New York's 19th congressional district special election for New York's 19th congressional district was held on August 23, 2022, to fill the vacancy created by Democratic U.S. representative Antonio Delgado who resigned to become lieutenant governor of New York. Democratic nominee Pat Ryan defeated Republican nominee Marc Molinaro in what was seen as an upset due to Molinaro's lead in polls and fundraising in the weeks leading to the election.

en.t: Chandrayaan-3 mission initiates first Moon landing in Indian history
en.s: Chandrayaan-3 (CHUN-drə-YAHN ) is the third mission in the Chandrayaan programme, a series of lunar-exploration missions developed by ISRO. The mission consists of Vikram, a lunar lander, and Pragyan, a lunar rover, as replacements for the equivalents on Chandrayaan-2, which had crashed on landing in 2019. Chandrayaan-3 was launched on 14 July 2023, at 14:35 IST from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) in Sriharikota, India.

zh.t: 钱德拉यान三号任务实现印度首次月面着陆
zh.s: 钱德拉यान三号是印度空间研究组织（ISRO）开发的月球探测计划中的第三次任务。任务由维克拉姆着陆器和普拉吉安月球车组成，用来替代钱德拉यान二号的对应设备；钱德拉यान二号曾在2019年着陆失败。钱德拉यान三号于2023年7月14日印度标准时间14时35分从印度斯里哈里科塔的萨蒂什·达万航天中心（SDSC）发射升空。

en.s: General elections were held throughout Zimbabwe on 23 and 24 August 2023 to elect the president, legislators and councillors. The main race for presidential office was between two candidates of Karanga origin: ZANU–PF's Emmerson Mnangagwa and Citizens Coalition for Change's Nelson Chamisa. The presidential election was won by the incumbent president Mnangagwa, while the governing ZANU–PF party won a majority of seats in parliament, with observer bodies describing the elections as not being free and fair.

en.s: The 2025 Under-20 Intercontinental Cup (Spanish: Sub-20 Intercontinental 2025) was the fourth edition of the UEFA–CONMEBOL Under-20 Intercontinental Cup, an annual one-off football match organised by CONMEBOL and UEFA between the winners of the U-20 Copa Libertadores and UEFA Youth League. As host confederation, CONMEBOL was in charge of the main organization of this edition. The match was played on 23 August 2025 at Maracanã Stadium in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, between the Brazilian team Flamengo, the 2025 U-20 Copa Libertadores champions and the title holders having won the previous edition, and Spanish team Barcelona, the 2024–25 UEFA Youth League champions.

zh.s: 2025年U-20洲际杯（西班牙语：Sub-20 Intercontinental 2025）是欧洲足联—南美足联U-20洲际杯的第4届赛事。这项赛事每年举行一场，由南美足联和欧洲足联组织，参赛双方分别是南美解放者杯U-20和欧洲青年联赛的冠军。本届由主办方南美足联负责主要组织工作。比赛于2025年8月23日在巴西里约热内卢马拉卡纳体育场举行，由巴西弗拉门戈队对阵西班牙巴塞罗那队。弗拉门戈是2025年南美解放者杯U-20冠军，也是上届赛事冠军；巴塞罗那则是2024—25赛季欧洲青年联赛冠军。
